details: Bitcoin dropped below $80,000 on October 24, triggering significant liquidations across the market, with over $828 million in crypto positions liquidated within 24 hours, predominantly long positions. Major altcoins also experienced sharp declines, reflecting a weakening market sentiment influenced by broader economic concerns and upcoming Federal Reserve meetings.
title: Bitcoin Dips Below $80K as Altcoins Plunge, $828M Liquidated

details: BitMEX co-founder Arthur Hayes announced on October 24 that his family office, Maelstrom, has exited its directional trading positions, selling assets including ETH, ENA, and UNI. Hayes cited profit-taking amidst mounting economic and geopolitical concerns, indicating a strategy to re-enter the market when conditions become more favorable.
title: Arthur Hayes Exits Directional Crypto Trades Amid Market Woes

details: Tether announced on October 24 that 15 leading Bitcoin mining operators, ASIC manufacturers, and mining pools have committed to integrating its open-source Mining Development Kit (MDK). This initiative aims to standardize mining infrastructure and facilitate AI-driven automation, with a stable 1.0 release targeted for year-end 2026.
title: Tether's MDK Gains Support from 15 Bitcoin Mining Firms

details: The cryptocurrency market is showing a persistent struggle to regain consistent demand as October draws to a close, maintaining a cautious tone among investors. The Fear & Greed Index has reverted to a neutral zone (48 points), signaling a decline in previous market enthusiasm, even as some traditional competing markets have become less appealing.
title: Crypto Market Struggles for Demand Recovery Amid Caution

details: Mike McGlone, a senior commodity strategist at Bloomberg, issued a warning that Bitcoin's price could plunge to $10,000 if the US stock market experiences a sustained 20% correction. He suggests that Bitcoin's increased mainstream adoption through ETFs has made it more susceptible to traditional market risks and volatility.
title: Bloomberg Analyst Warns Bitcoin Could Drop to $10K

details: Remittix has announced a permanent burn of 300 million RTX tokens at its launch, which will reduce the original supply by 20%. This strategic tokenomics event, set before its November 24 public trading debut, aims to create scarcity and follows a successful capital raise of $33 million from over 40,000 participants.
title: Remittix Announces 300 Million RTX Token Burn

details: Bitcoin Core updated its security policy on October 22 to expedite fixes and disclosures for "easily discoverable" vulnerabilities, including those identified by advanced AI tools. This change aims to provide node operators with patches more quickly, abandoning previous longer embargo periods for such bugs.
title: Bitcoin Core Fast-Tracks Security Fixes for AI-Discoverable Bugs

details: On October 23, wallets linked to BlackRock's spot Bitcoin ETFs transferred 3,215 BTC ($262.4 million) and 38,882 ETH ($93.2 million) to Coinbase Prime. While such large movements can alarm crypto enthusiasts, this activity is likely routine fund management for existing redemptions rather than an indication of new selling pressure.
title: BlackRock Moves $355M in BTC & ETH to Coinbase Prime

details: Six additional companies, including financial giants Wells Fargo and Intuit, along with Arm Holdings, have formally objected to having their shares tokenized on OKXICE, a joint trading platform proposed by crypto exchange OKX and Intercontinental Exchange. This brings the total number of objectors to 22, underscoring increasing challenges for blockchain-based stock trading initiatives.
title: Wells Fargo, Intuit & Arm Object to Tokenized Stock Platform

details: JPMorgan Chase has officially launched its JPM Coin deposit token on the public Ethereum blockchain network. This strategic move aims to expand the reach of institutional finance into public blockchain ecosystems, making the token available to J.P. Morgan's institutional clientele.
title: JPMorgan Launches JPM Coin on Public Ethereum Blockchain

details: The U.S. Internal Revenue Service (IRS) is preparing to revise its voluntary disclosure program, with plans to reduce penalties and expedite the resolution of tax violations, including those involving cryptocurrencies. The updated program is anticipated to be introduced before December, targeting case resolutions within 120 days.
title: IRS to Lower Penalties for Crypto Tax Disclosures
